decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The roof area of the rear extension shall not be altered or adapted for use as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 3 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification) no windows or other openings (other than those expressly authorised by this permission) shall be formed in the walls or roof of the extension permitted.

Condition : 5 - The front garden of the property shall be brought into use for car parking purposes, in accordance with drawing No. 04 received 14th September 2005, prior to works on the rear extension being commenced, and the front garden parking area shall thereafter be retained.

Condition : 6 - Access to the front garden parking area, hereby approved, shall only be obtained via the existing shared driveway. The existing front garden wall shall be retained where it adjoins the public pavement.

Condition : 7 - Informative:
1		The applicants are advised that if any removal of asbestos is proposed in the demolition of existing structures prior to development taking place they should contact the Pollution Control Section on Tel. No. 020 8583 5172
description: Erection of single storey rear extension to house following removal of attached rear shed and canopy
